scope: Read-only current-source capability crawl of exactly 149 assigned paths; discover a small toolkit, not recreate 149 CLIs. No migration/retirement/parity/deletion credit.
method: Every assigned current file read as bytes, hash-checked and fully parsed/traversed with Python AST; imports/docstrings/functions/calls/I/O/guards inspected. Historical family/purpose hints were not used to assign capabilities.

Direct facade delegates and static re-export targets resolved to current provider bodies, separately AST-traversed and pinned. Dynamic globals/context callbacks, importlib and runtime external classifiers remain explicit limits.

Five representative retired bodies read through git show at the recorded historical commit, never executed and not treated as exact source oracle. Other current refusal stubs remain historical-use-case unknowns.
All analysis commands ran nice -n 19. No old script, emulator, PINE, test suite, registry update or ISO write was executed.
Per-script import statements were inspected during traversal; the compact artifact keeps concrete static delegate targets and provider pins instead of repeating import syntax.

registry_merge.responsibility: Normalize stable IDs; validate/import authored entries or merge allowed machine fields into a new snapshot. Human wording and machine metadata have different owners.
registry_merge.shared: Go registry_merge / run registry snapshot branch; historical registry_import validators and registry.merge_entry show existing reusable contracts.
registry_merge.facts: IDs, wording, glossary entries, per-pool batches, approved updates and dates as data.
registry_merge.guards: Duplicate normalized IDs; missing fields; speaker/marker/glyph integrity; conflicts; locked/backward statuses; human-field ownership; preserve unknown metadata; source hash and exclusive output.

registry_reconcile.responsibility: Compare canonical plan with independently read on-disc bytes/references and propose differences. Report before mutating.
registry_reconcile.shared: Existing registry_merge + controls + pointer/source inspection; retain separate evidence stage.
registry_reconcile.facts: Expected source image, registry IDs, pointer forms, optional historical ledgers and scope.
registry_reconcile.guards: Current source identity; reconstruct signed low halves; ref topology; exact stream termination; distinguish byte equality from normalized wording and gameplay proof.

binary_edit.responsibility: Plan typed equal-size old/new edits, source guards, whole-copy application/revert and readback.
binary_edit.shared: Go plan guarded_words / same_length_stream / stream_append, validateEdits, verifySource, patchCopy.
binary_edit.facts: Addresses, explicit preimages, documented instruction words, dependencies and bounded landing spans; no one function per repair.
binary_edit.guards: Complete before/new-state sets; reject partial install; alignment and overlap; original and shipping protection; delay slots/opcodes/registers; source/hash; readback and whole-image containment.

image_layout.responsibility: Map VMA/file/ISO ranges and validate or grow ISO9660/ELF/stream capacity.
image_layout.shared: Go inspect, isoFileExtent, stream_allocate/stream_grow; existing segment-aware addr behavior exceeds fixed-delta assumptions.
image_layout.facts: Segments, named extents, loader/window sites, directory records, prior/new sector counts, safe ranges and margins.
image_layout.guards: Both-endian fields; all reachable metadata/extent containment; unchanged unrelated files; preserve existing blob; loader count/window coherence; bounded address arithmetic; initialized vs file-backed vs BSS distinctions.

text_codec_fit.responsibility: Decode/encode game text and inspect native line/byte/layout constraints or apply bounded edits.
text_codec_fit.shared: Go encode, controls, wrapPages; authoring report remains distinct from strict target-pinned patch plan.
text_codec_fit.facts: Canonical wording, source contexts, fixed reader capacity, independent consumer/native geometry and supported numeric argument bounds.
text_codec_fit.guards: Source control order; final pauses; unknown opaque arguments; per-reader semantics; actual native advances vs character budgets; no false fit from normalized text.

artifact_snapshot.responsibility: Create/index/hash immutable snapshots and restore or inventory explicit versions.
artifact_snapshot.shared: Existing backup_iso.cmd_snapshot/cmd_restore and Go exclusive-copy safety; OS copy/hash primitives.
artifact_snapshot.facts: Source/output paths, tags, commit, digest, size and provenance.
artifact_snapshot.guards: Never original target; verify stored digest before/after restore; duplicate-tag ambiguity; exclusive output/inode identity; no accidental overwrite or sharing mutable scratch.

evidence_report.responsibility: Derived exports, progress/structural checks and byte/registry audits from explicit inputs.
evidence_report.shared: Existing reports registry/text/writeback/verify; Go text_shapes and reference_candidates for supported structural pieces.
evidence_report.facts: Selectors, thresholds, baseline and tracked-case requirements, output format only when needed.
evidence_report.guards: Report status counts/recorded state are not functional success; evidence tied to source hash; escaped HTML; honest unknowns; no hidden writes to canonical inputs.

candidate_compose.responsibility: Compose reviewed edit sets into a new disposable image/private registry and prove expected-only changes.
candidate_compose.shared: Go composed plan + patchCopy; prepare_layout_candidate.compose/compare demonstrates independent full-image containment.
candidate_compose.facts: Ordered prerequisites and typed proposals, source identities, exact declared edit sets.
candidate_compose.guards: Exclusive output; replan/readback/idempotence; reject edit overlap or preimage drift; preserve sources; verify every outside-edit byte unchanged; scope diagnostic fixtures away from shipping.

instrumentation.responsibility: Prepare versioned diagnostic hook/counter capture plans; read saved/live values only through an explicitly owned runtime workflow.
instrumentation.shared: Guarded-word edit engine + versioned probe facts; live process control/capture remains a separate service.
instrumentation.facts: Hook sites, disassembly, register/counter layout, zero reservation, prior version prerequisites, capture addresses.
instrumentation.guards: Observed zero bytes are not safe allocation proof; preserve displaced instructions/delay slots; shared game loop/RPC flags; owned process/profile/socket; live read availability is not visual verification.

retired_gate.responsibility: Current entrypoint refuses; preserve provenance and use-case record without counting removed historical behavior as current implementation.
retired_gate.shared: One explicit disposition/provenance inventory, not a new legacy CLI compatibility framework.
retired_gate.facts: Original commit/path, current fail-closed route and known replacement.
retired_gate.guards: Do not infer historical safety/parity from refusal stub or current file family hint.

top_findings.finding: Many dated code/probe scripts already share the same old/new-state, dry-run, protected-target, guarded-write and readback algorithm.
top_findings.why_shared: Patch bytes/sites, register layout, prior hook and capture words change; transaction policy does not. Existing guarded_words/verifySource/patchCopy is the candidate owner. Keep specialized instruction/consumer proofs as recipe facts. No need one Go handler per probe version.

top_findings.finding: Registry import, human editing and machine writeback are three reusable use cases with different permissions; do not flatten into arbitrary JSON update.
top_findings.why_shared: Normalized stable IDs, conflict detection and snapshot persistence recur. Required fields, authored batches and old/new scope are data. Human ownership, locked statuses, append-only import and three-way disc-to-registry reconciliation remain explicit contracts.

top_findings.finding: Reports should consume a shared source/reference/text inspection result, but legacy report layouts do not deserve compatibility adapters by default.
top_findings.why_shared: They independently resolve pointers, decode text, compare canonical/actual state and group findings. Source identity, raw bytes/control sequence and typed reference resolution are shared facts. Preserve ambiguous/unsupported buckets; ledger pinned special decoders require proof before collapse.

top_findings.finding: ISO/ELF mapping, physical capacity and runtime sentinel window are distinct reusable responsibilities.
top_findings.why_shared: Same source extent/tree and typed address checks recur, while loaders/windows impose independent limits. Do not merge physical allocation and runtime reachability based only on matching constants or a fixed VMA delta.

top_findings.finding: Private candidate composition and whole-image containment are valuable general operations beyond translating strings.
top_findings.why_shared: Plan against pinned identities, create exclusive new copy, assert every preimage, replan/readback and compare all changed bytes; patch/fixture facts vary. Existing Go plan+patchCopy can own application; fixture recipes must remain diagnostically scoped.

top_findings.finding: Runtime orchestration needs explicit owned process boundaries; it is not another binary patch operation.
top_findings.why_shared: Instrument installation, live RAM reads, process launch/cleanup and archived proof checking are different steps. bisect uses global flatpak kill, which must not become shared core behavior. Saved run flags do not imply visual/gameplay acceptance.

hazards_to_retain: Before/after source pins and complete state sets; reject partially applied coupled changes.
No original/shipping writes except separately authorized workflow; new exclusive scratch outputs with inode checks, preserved inputs, readback and whole-image containment.
Zero bytes are not dead-code/data proof; preserve branch, stride, GP, raw pointer, high/low reconstruction and all consumer evidence.
Distinguish file layout, runtime address window, loader transfer size and consumer buffer size; validate both-endian directory records and all reachable metadata extents.
Preserve meaningful controls, positional segments, argument order, final pauses, numeric domains and direct/fixed-reader behavior.
Canonical human wording and machine metadata have separate owners; reject duplicate IDs, mismatched old wording and backward statuses unless an explicitly documented recovery.
Reports/classifiers are advisory. Counts, approximate encoded length, normalized wording, state-file tracking and archived flags are weaker than exact bytes and gameplay.
Avoid default global target paths, silent overwrite, live process kill and dynamic context/plugin frameworks in a new toolkit.
obsolete_or_repair_candidates_not_deleti: Current reference-only stubs and metadata disposition gates contain no active original engine; retain provenance and unknown historical obligations rather than implementing their CLI.
Successive probe/loader variants can become versioned payload facts only after their distinct prerequisites and safety invariants are represented.
Dated done-count/tracked-goal cases can be case data for one evidence checker; do not preserve print formatting or weak success definitions gratuitously.
Fixed keyboard/settings sentinel reversions show that some earlier general migrations were wrong for their consumers. They are repair evidence, not a general force/revert mode.
Handwritten duplicate codec and ledger-specific decoders are consolidation candidates only after source/control/termination parity is proven.
